content: Our experiment results show significant improvements over previous methods. Further experiments demonstrate that our model also achieves considerable improvement over other off-the-shelf state-of-the-art models under classification and question answering framework respectively. Ablation tests carried out by taking off some components of our model further prove its robustness and effectiveness.
